question.text:
Given below are two statements I and II.
Statement I: Dumas method is used for estimation of "Nitrogen" in an organic compound.
Statement II: Dumas method involves the formation of ammonium sulphate by heating the organic compound with conc $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct answer from the options given below

options.text: Statement I is true but Statement II is false
Both Statement I and Statement II are false
Statement I is false but Statement II is true
Both Statement I and Statement II are true

solution.text: In Dumas method nitrogen present in organic compound is converted into $\mathrm{N}_2$ gas whose volumetric analysis gives the percentage of nitrogen atom in the organic compound.
